beats.speech: Stop saying very hard. Here are three better words.

card.headline: Tough
card.use: Ana wants to climb a mountain.

beats.speech: Tough: Ana wants to climb a mountain. It's a tough climb.
Tricky: Then the path turns icy. Every step is tricky.
Brutal: But she reaches the top! What a brutal climb!
Which word will you use? Comment yours!

language_approval.notes: tough climb / tricky icy steps / brutal climb (informal: very hard, Cambridge) natural; tricky slightly milder but fits icy path; no caps
